category_edits.rationale: Widen each bidirectional Transformer block's GELU feed-forward intermediate layer from 2× to 3× hidden width across all four category models. Additional nonlinear capacity may improve context interactions. The predictor imports this same model class, preserving checkpoint shape consistency. Keep embeddings, attention, residuals, masked training, readout, loss and optimizer unchanged.

response.change_summary: Increase BERT4Rec feed-forward width from 2× to 3× hidden size for all four independently trained category models; inference uses the updated architecture through its existing model-class import.
